# Vocollision

> Premier competitive a cappella group at New York University (NYU) in New York City.

Vocollision is an inventive, diverse collegiate a cappella group founded in 2008. The group is ICCA-recognized and available for booking, collaborations, and auditions.

## Site

- Home: https://vocollision.com/
- About: https://vocollision.com/about/
- NYC a cappella guide: https://vocollision.com/nyc-acapella/
- Contact / booking: https://vocollision.com/contact/
- Auditions: https://vocollision.com/audition/

## Contact

- Booking & general: nyu.vocollision@gmail.com
- Location: New York University, New York City, NY, USA

## Key facts

- Type: Competitive collegiate a cappella / MusicGroup
- School: New York University (NYU)
- Founded: 2008
- Known for: Inventive sets, diverse repertoire, ICCA awards, NYC performances
- Open to: All voice parts and beatboxers (auditions)

## ICCA awards

Vocollision has earned multiple International Championships of Collegiate A Cappella (ICCA) awards, including:

- 2025 ICCA Quarterfinals — Outstanding Arrangement; Outstanding Vocal Percussion; Quarterfinal Second Place
- 2024 ICCA Semifinals — Outstanding Choreography; Semifinal Fourth Place
- 2024 ICCA Quarterfinals — Quarterfinal Champions; Outstanding Arrangement; Outstanding Choreography; Outstanding Vocal Percussion
- 2023 ICCA Quarterfinals — Outstanding Vocal Percussion; Quarterfinal Second Place
- 2021 ICCA Quarterfinals — Quarterfinal Champions; Outstanding Arrangement; Outstanding Video
